title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Shortness of breath.

HPI
Pt is a 56 y.o. female presenting for f/u of COPD. Pt reports mild dyspnea on exertion but denies increased sputum production, fever, or chills. She states her symptoms are well-managed with current regimen. No recent URI or environmental exposures noted. Pt reports good compliance with inhalers.

Medication List
1. Tiotropium (Spiriva) 1 inhalation QD
2. Salmeterol/Fluticasone (Advair) 1 inhalation BID
3. Albuterol HFA 2 puffs PRN

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
Resp: CTAB, RRR, no wheezing or crackles.
CV: RRR, no murmurs.
Ext: No edema.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 74, RR 16, SpO2 96% on RA.

Assessment
1. COPD: Pt is stable at this time. Symptoms reviewed.

Plan
1. COPD: Continue current maintenance medications. Pt to monitor for increased cough or secretions. F/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed, D. Kowalski, MD, 05/14/2026
explanations: The provider addressed COPD at this visit (status and plan documented), so it is supported and coded.

distractors.why: Status plus a plan in the assessment supports the diagnosis.

hccs.label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease/Interstitial Lung Disorders/and Other Chronic Lung Disorders
